column1: # Venus Lighthouse Aerie: first confrontation, Sheba's hostage crisis, the Shaman's Rod bargain and first battle.

column3: At last. Venus\nLighthouse is within\nour reach.{end_wait}
After Venus, only\nJupiter and Mars\nwill remain.{end_wait}
Jupiter is next.\nMars comes last.{end_wait}
Then we cannot stop\nuntil both are lit.{end_wait}
Wait. I need to\nspeak with you.{end_wait}
Why have you returned,\n{actor_name:5}?{end_wait}
You were supposed\nto go on to the ship.{end_wait}
I sent {actor_name:6} and the\nothers ahead to Idejima.{end_wait}
Then what brings\nyou back here?{end_wait}
I gave my word.\nI won't break it.{end_wait}
Your word? To whom?{end_wait}
To {actor_name:7}, of course.{end_wait}
Then why is {actor_name:7}\nstill here?{end_wait}
You said she could\nleave when we reached\nVenus Lighthouse.{end_wait}
So that's why\nyou came back.{end_wait}
She never chose\nto come with us.\nYou promised her freedom.{end_wait}
We still need\n{actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
So you meant to\nkeep her all along.{end_wait}
Because {actor_name:7} is\na Wind Adept?{end_wait}
The first two beacons\ntaught me what\nthe next one needs.{end_wait}
Then you know\nour problem.{end_wait}
Each lighthouse needs\nan Adept of its\nown element.{end_wait}
We have Earth, Fire,\nand Water among us...{pause_20_skippable}\nbut no Wind Adept.{end_wait}
So you've understood{pause_20_skippable}.{end_wait}
And you need {actor_name:7}\nto enter Jupiter\nLighthouse?{end_wait}
Yes, {actor_name:5}.\nWithout Wind, Jupiter\nwill stay closed.{end_wait}
You never meant\nto free {actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
We have no choice.{page_break}Go now, {actor_name:5}.\nLet us finish this.{end_wait}
Not without\n{actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
I'm taking {actor_name:7}\nto the ship. Now.{end_wait}
You would defy us,\n{actor_name:5}?{end_wait}
The beacon could\nkill {actor_name:7}.\nI won't leave her here.{end_wait}
I promised to keep\n{actor_name:7} safe. Haven't\nI kept my word?{end_wait}
Then ask her{pause_20_skippable}\nwhat she wants.{end_wait}
You may go, {actor_name:5}.\n{actor_name:7} must stay.{end_wait}
Why not?{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} What?{pause_20_skippable}\nYou don't trust me?{end_wait}
You've turned on us.\nWhy trust you with\n{actor_name:7} now?{end_wait}
We can't let\n{actor_name:7} leave in\nyour care.{end_wait}
Come, {actor_name:7}.\nI'll take you\nto the ship.{end_wait}
Will you fight\nus over her?{end_wait}
He has made his\nchoice, Saturos.{page_break}He knows what\nstanding here will cost.{end_wait}
If I have to fight\nfor {actor_name:7}, I will.{end_wait}
You know our power.\nDon't make us\nuse it against you.{end_wait}
You cannot protect\n{actor_name:7}{pause_20_skippable} if you fall\ntrying to stop us.{end_wait}
This is what it\ncomes to after all\nwe've endured?{end_wait}
Think how far we've\ncome. Don't throw\nit away now.{end_wait}
Stand aside,\n{actor_name:5}. Don't test us.{end_wait}
Enough talk!{pause_20_skippable} If you\nmean to fight, fight!{end_wait}
They're going to\nfight over {actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
Has anyone asked\nwhat she wants?{end_wait}
They're watching\n{actor_name:5}, not us.\nWe have an opening.{end_wait}
Then let's reach\nthe beacon before\nthey can light it.{end_wait}
Should we stop them\nbefore they light it?{end_now}
Then move!{pause_20_skippable} They may\nsee us any moment!{end_wait}
Hesitate now, and\nwe may lose our chance.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}...{end_wait}
So{pause_20_skippable} you followed us\nall the way here?{end_wait}
Your defiance has\nbrought them here,\n{actor_name:5}.{end_wait}
Stay back, {actor_name:1}.\nI can handle this.{end_wait}
I came to settle\nthis myself.{page_break}I won't ask you\nto fight my battle.{end_wait}
The beacon isn't safe.\nNo one knows what\nit will do next.{end_wait}
But {actor_name:7} doesn't\ndeserve this. Let\n{actor_name:7} go!{end_wait}
Enough!{pause_20_skippable} One more\nmove, {actor_name:5}, and\n{actor_name:7} is in danger.{end_wait}
Faran trusted us\nto bring {actor_name:7}\nhome alive.{end_wait}
We won't let you\nhurt {actor_name:7} or\n{actor_name:5}!{end_wait}
So you care about\n{actor_name:7} as well?{end_wait}
Then listen.{pause_20_skippable} Give us\nwhat we need, and\n{actor_name:7} won't be harmed.{end_wait}
Saturos, what are\nyou doing?{end_wait}
A bargain. Nothing more.{end_wait}
{actor_name:7}!{pause_20_skippable} Have you heard\nof the rod from\nHesperia?{end_wait}
The Rod of Hesperia?{end_wait}
The Shaman's Rod.\nIt opens the way to\nJupiter Lighthouse.{end_wait}
Yes{pause_20_skippable}. I've heard of it.{end_wait}
The ones chasing us\nhave a rod. Is it\nthe one we need?{end_wait}
{actor_name:7}, stay there.\nTry from where\nyou stand.{end_wait}
Can you sense it,\n{actor_name:7}?{end_wait}
Tell us what you can,\n{actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
...{pause_20_skippable}...{pause_20_skippable}...{pause_20_skippable}\nPerhaps...{pause_20_skippable}...{pause_20_skippable}...{pause_20_skippable}{end_wait}
Perhaps?{pause_20_skippable} We need\nmore than that.\nPlease, try again.{end_wait}
Stop frightening her!{end_wait}
We're not shouting!{pause_20_skippable}\nWe need a clear answer.{end_wait}
So, {actor_name:7}?{end_wait}
I can't see it\nclearly...{pause_20_skippable} But\nI think it's the one.{pause_20_skippable}{end_wait}
That's enough.\nWe have our answer.{end_wait}
So, what do we do?{end_wait}
Do you know what we\nwill demand before we\nspare {actor_name:7}?{end_now}
Then you already\nknow what I want.{end_wait}
The Shaman's Rod.\nHand it over.{end_wait}
Give us the rod, and\n{actor_name:7} won't be harmed.\nAgreed?{end_now}
I don't like this.{pause_20_skippable}\nBut {actor_name:7}'s life\ncomes first.{end_wait}
If it keeps\n{actor_name:7} safe, then\nwe have to do it.{end_wait}
But Hammet gave it\nto you, {actor_name:3}!{pause_20_skippable}\nCan we trust them?{end_wait}
Would you risk\n{actor_name:7}'s life to\nkeep the rod?{end_wait}
Then take {text_effect:2}the rod!{reset_text_style}{end_wait}
At last, Saturos.\nThe Shaman's Rod\nis ours.{end_wait}
Fetch it, {actor_name:5}.{end_wait}
Why me?{end_wait}
Show me that you\nstill keep your word.{end_wait}
Go on, {actor_name:5}!{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} surrendered\nthe Shaman's Rod.{end_wait}
What do you want\nme to do with it?{end_wait}
Keep it safe.{end_wait}
Where are you going,\n{actor_name:7}?{end_wait}
You have the rod.\nNow let {actor_name:7} go.{end_wait}
Why would we do that?{end_wait}
You promised to\nrelease {actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
Those{pause_20_skippable} were your words.\nNot ours.{end_wait}
We've done what you\nasked. Let {actor_name:7}\ngo home.{end_wait}
You tricked us!{end_wait}
We promised she\nwouldn't be harmed.\nNo more than that.{end_wait}
How would {actor_name:7}\nreach Lalivero\non her own?{end_wait}
Then let her come\nwith us.{end_wait}
Take {actor_name:7} from us\nif you can. Those\nare your choices.{end_wait}
Take {actor_name:7}?{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nYou mean we'd have\nto fight for her.{end_wait}
That's right.{pause_20_skippable} Your\njourney ends here.{end_wait}
Then you've left\nus no choice.{end_wait}
Enough!{pause_20_skippable} You'll have\nto get through us!{end_wait}
Then face us.\nYou followed us\nto the end.{end_wait}
You don't know\nwhat we stand to lose.{end_wait}
They're down.\nWe stopped them.{end_wait}
